configure_profiling: configure habitat profiling to start capturing at a specific step and capture a set number of steps
on_start_step: signal the profiler that the capture start step has been reached during simulation
range_push: push a named profiling range marker to annotate a code block for Nsight Systems tracing
range_pop: pop the most recent profiling range marker to end an annotated code block
RangeContext: use a context manager or decorator to annotate a code block with a profiling range message
